description.text: I-Corps Hub West empowers researchers across the Western U.S. to turn deep-tech innovations into scalable ventures through NSF-sponsored training.

targetApplicants.text: As Technologists, we thrive at the cutting edge of discovery, bridging the critical gap between the known and the yet-to-be understood. And as Incubators of Innovation, we cultivate environments where exploration and experimentation are celebrated, empowering teams to push boundaries without fear of failure. This distinctive blend makes us more than a program. We are a catalyst for bold breakthroughs and lasting economic impact.

sources.quote: I-Corps™ Hub West top of page Menu Close Home Our Program Schedule Our Impact Newsroom Leadership Contact Home Our Program Schedule Our Impact Newsroom Leadership Contact Partner Portal I-Corps Hub West Impact 11 Partner Institutions 1612 Regional Teams Trained 170 Startups Formed 935 Jobs Created 11,600 Program Participants $303M Raised in Follow-up Funding I-Corps Hub West We explore the commercialization potential of technologies developed in academic labs across Southern California, Colorado, Utah, New Mexico, and Northwest Texas Our Program Ecosystem Network We connect deep tech innovators at academic institutions with a vibrant community of mentors and industry leaders. Innovation Pipeline We help to explore and expand the commercialization potential of cutting-edge technologies across our region. Economic Impact We support deep tech commercialization to drive regional economic growth and strengthen local industries. Our Mission & Vision To lead the exploration of commercializing deep technologies emerging from academic institutions into real-world solutions with measurable economic impact. ​ To ensure that every deep technology discovery made has the opportunity to reach a commercialized environment, so that the maximum impact available can become realized.
